mails.subject: Re: Booking confirmation, Studio B on Friday
mails.body:
> Your booking of Studio B for Friday 23 October, 13:00 to 15:00, is confirmed.

Thanks. One change: our team has grown by two people, so we need a larger room. Could you move us to the Atrium room instead, same Friday slot, if it is free?

If the Atrium is taken, we could also start at 15:00 instead. Please let me know by tomorrow, as the guests are travelling in and need to be told where to go.

Gustav
mails.justification: A member asks to change a room booking for this week, a booking change needing a reply within 24 hours.

mails.subject: Location d'une salle pour une journée
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Désolée pour mon message envoyé depuis le téléphone, il y aura sûrement des fautes.

Je suis photographe et je prépare un shooting avec 3 modèles et mon assistante, sans date précise, sûrement fin octobre ou début novembre. Je cherche une grande salle lumineuse à louer pour une journée complète. Est-ce que vous louez à des personnes qui ne sont pas membres ? Quelle est la surface de la plus grande salle ? Et est-ce qu'on peut avoir un accés à une prise 380 volts ou au moins plusieurs rallonges ?

Merci d'avance pour votre répones,
Amélie Fontaine
06 55 12 40 88
Envoyé de mon iPhone

mails.subject: Co-branded Christmas market? 🎄
mails.body:
Hey team! 👋

We're Tinyhands, we run a small handmade-goods market on Sundays across Copenhagen. We love your space and have a fun idea: a joint Christmas pop-up market in your main hall on the first weekend of December 🎅

We'd handle the stalls and marketing, you'd get your name on all posters and a share of the stall fees (we were thinking 20 percent). We could also do a short press piece about the space with the local paper we work with.

Want to hop on a call next week or just grab a coffee at your place? No rush, we're planning for December anyway 😊

Warm hugs,
Lars and Josefine
mails.justification: An organisation proposes a co-branded event and a press piece, a partnership proposal with no immediate deadline.

mails.subject: Nuisances sonores, étage 2
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Veuillez agréer nos salutations distinguées.

Direction des opérations

mails.subject: Locked out, and charged twice for the room?
mails.body:
Hi,

My access card stopped working this morning. The door light is red and I cannot get in. I have a client demo at 10:00 and my laptop and monitor setup are inside.

I also see two charges of 450 DKK on my card for the Harbour room yesterday. I only booked it once. Could you check that too, but the door comes first, please.

You can call me on 55 09 31 77, I am standing outside.

Oliver Wright
Wright Cloud
mails.justification: A member is locked out with a demo that morning, so a complaint needing action today, with a double charge mentioned.

mails.subject: Re: Thank you for the event on 3 October
mails.body:
Hi both,

> It was a pleasure to have you. We hope to see you again.

Just a quick note to say thank you again. The launch went really well, about 70 guests came, and many of them said how much they liked the space, the coffee and the staff on the evening. Several guests have already asked for our next date, so you may hear from us in the new year.

We have no questions and nothing is outstanding on our side, the invoice was paid on Monday as agreed, so please do not spend time answering this.

A couple of photos from the evening are in the shared folder we mentioned, in case you want to use them on your site. Feel free to, we are happy with it, just for your information.

The sound technician especially deserves a mention. He stayed an extra hour to fix a problem with a microphone and did not even ask for anything in return. Please pass on our thanks.

Warm regards,
Rikke Sandberg
Sandberg Events
mails.justification: A thank-you reply in a thread containing no request, so category other with nothing to answer.

mails.subject: Glemt jakke + hvad med nyhedsbrevet?
mails.body:
Hej,

Jeg har været i jeres fællesskab i fredags og tror, jeg har glemt min grå jakke på knagen ved køkkenet. Der er en blå nøglering i lommen med et lille sort kamera på. Har I fundet den? Jeg kan hente den en dag i næste uge, bare sig hvornår der er nogen.

Og så en lille ting: jeg tilmeldte mig jeres nyhedsbrev i sommer, men har ikke fået noget siden august. Måske er min mail gået i spam? Min adresse er bent.skov@skovkonsulent.example, men det er ikke vigtigt, bare hvis I lige kan tjekke.

Hilsen
Bent Skov
Sendt fra min iPhone
